| Exhibition | Artist | Years of the artist’s life |
|------------|--------|----------------------------|

- Hilma af Klint died in 1944, long before the 2022 exhibition period (22 Sep 2022 – 8 Jan 2023).

The other single‑artist specials held in 2022—*Four Months, Four Million Light Years* (Sara Sejin Chang), *Who are you really?* (Jeppe Hein), *Alive time* (Every Ocean Hughes), *This Will Not End Well* (Nan Goldin), *From dying to living* (Korakrit Arunanondchai), *The Surrounding Reality* (Björn Lövin), and *Alternative Secrecy* (Annika Elisabeth von Hausswolff)—all involved living artists.
